title: Measuring Delivery Consistency in Practice: A DORA Extension from a Multi-Platform Release Setting
abstract: arXiv:2606.00364v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The DevOps Research and Assessment (DORA) framework is the most widely adopted measurement system for performance measurement across engineering teams. However, every DORA metric is a first-moment statistic or a simple ratio, which limits the potential insights into engineering process. For example, metrics like Deployment Frequency do not capture the distributional shape of deployment timing, so teams with identical measures can deploy on a metronomic cadence or in undesirably erratic bursts. We have been developing and piloting Delivery Consistency (DC), a bounded second-moment measure of cadence regularity derived from the coefficient of variation of inter-release intervals. In conjunction with other DORA concepts, we integrated DC into the Delivery Health Matrix, an eight-archetype diagnostic that maps joint readings to differentiated interventions. translated_title: 实践中的交付一致性度量：来自多平台发布场景的DORA框架扩展
translated_abstract: DevOps研究与评估（DORA）框架是工程团队绩效测量中采用最广泛的度量体系。然而，每一项DORA指标都是一阶矩统计量或简单的比值，这限制了其对工程流程的潜在洞察。例如，部署频率等指标无法反映部署时间分布的形态，因此度量值相同的团队，既可能以节拍器般规律的节奏进行部署，也可能以不合意的爆发式节奏进行部署。我们一直在开发并试点“交付一致性”，这是一种有界的二阶矩度量，通过发布间隔的变异系数推导得出，用于衡量交付节奏的规律性。结合其他DORA概念，我们将DC整合进“交付健康矩阵”中——这是一个包含八种原型的诊断工具，可将联合读数映射为差异化的干预措施。我们报告了在一个四平台软件交付团队上进行的一项经验评估。
tldr: 该论文提出“交付一致性”（DC）这一有界二阶矩度量指标，弥补了DORA指标无法反映部署节奏规律性的不足，并将其整合进包含八种原型的“交付健康矩阵”诊断框架，在多平台软件交付环境中进行了实践评估。
